cases.name: Teresa Kay Turner
cases.about: She lived in Bellevue, NE with her parents and had plans to attend Metropolitan Technical Community College that fall to study computer science.
cases.narrative: On 8/17/1984, Teresa was found dead in her grandmother's ceramic shop. She had massive head injuries from a large ceramic mold used to beat her and had a dozen puncture wounds in her back. Cause of death was traumatic brain injury.
